op.description: ls = see your settings, set = change some, rm = undo some of your changes, reset = undo all your changes

long.description: ls: also show where each key comes from (definition, or agent = changed by you)

settings.description: set: the keys to change and their new values (strings), like {"model": "smart-high"}

keys.description: rm: the keys you changed and want back to your definition's value
